draft.subject: Your weekly summary question, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for raising the weekly summary email — as Tariq mentioned on your now-closed ticket, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. Sorry it wasn't the answer you were hoping for.

Since the kickoff, the next step that tends to make everything else easier is getting a first project in place — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. When you're ready, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
